A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the majority of asthma patients in the community setting are not achieving optimal control, and the reasons for this are complex and not well understood.
asthma is a complex chronic disease that requires individualization of care.
the current asthma treatment guidelines are too complicated for the average patient and physician, and therefore not useful in real world practice.

the use of a single, simple metric for asthma control is inadequate for the management of patients with asthma in real-world clinical settings.
